quests.title: A True Foe - The Giadrome!
quests.details:
Within a group of the sly
carnivorous Giaprey, there
is a leader. They call it
the Giadrome. I need a
hunter's strength to show
that pack of beasts and
their leader who's boss!

quests.title: Reckless Bulldrome Hunter
quests.details:
My son decided to become a
hunter and ran off after a
Bulldrome on his own! Of
course, now the tables have
turned and I'm worried!
Hunt down the Bulldrome on
the snowy mountains!

quests.title: A Pack of Blangos
quests.details:
A large pack of Blangos are
massing nearby. They are
violent enough that a large
group will quickly become
uncontrollable. Please slay
15 of the apes!

quests.title: Mountain Herb Picking
quests.details:
I want to pick some of this
village's famous Mountain
Herbs for my brother in
town, but there are too many
monsters! Could you please
go out for me and bring back
20 Mountain Herbs?

quests.title: Rarest of the Rare Beasts
quests.details:
Do you know of a pink,
fanged beast that roams the
jungle? That beast has
dirtied my shop beyond hope!
It's impossible to clean up!
Get rid of it before I'm
soiled again!

quests.title: Hunt the Rare Forest Congas!
quests.details:
I took a trip to the jungle
and saw some beautiful pink
animals with fangs. But when
I tried to pet them from my
carriage, the beasts made a
stink on me! I can't get it
off! Punish those meanies!

quests.title: A Mushroom Goldrush!
quests.details:
Mushrooms from the jungle
are skyrocketing in price!
If you were to gather 20 of
them for me, you would be
justly compensated. However,
I hear the area is infested
with carnivores, so beware!

quests.title: The Land Shark
quests.details:
A villager was tracking a 
pack of monsters, but lost 
sight of them in the desert.
Please find the leader of
the pack and hunt it down
for us.

quests.title: The Giant Enemy Crab
quests.details:
A giant crab is wandering
around the desert! However,
no normal sword is capable
of cracking its shell! I
hate to ask for help from
other hunters, but please
lend me your skills!

quests.title: The Lady Gourmet
quests.details:
I travel the world for new
tastes and flavors. Now I
want to try the liver of a
Piscine Wyvern, a taste few
others have experienced.
Please bring me 8 of these
livers!

quests.title: The Shadow in the Mountains
quests.details:
We were exploring a
snow-covered mountain near
here, but stumbled on this
disgusting blob-like
monster! If you can't get
rid of that thing, our
research is doomed! Help us!

quests.title: The King of the Mountains
quests.details:
A Blangonga has staked its
claim to a piece of the
snowy mountains. Now we
can't enter the area to
gather firewood. Exterminate
the Blangonga!

quests.title: A Swarm of Hermitaurs
quests.details:
Fishing is no easy endeavor,
but lately things have
gotten out of hand! While
unloading my ship, a swarm
of Hermitaurs appeared. Slay
10 of them and let me get
on with my work!

quests.title: Water Wyvern in the Desert
quests.details:
I found a giant water wyvern
in a cave in the desert! I
can't defeat it because it 
stays underwater. Slay it
for me and the glory is all
yours!

quests.title: Gypceros: Venomous Terror
quests.details:
The fields all around the
town are getting torn to
shreds by a gigantic
poisonous bird-like monster.
Exterminate it for us! Its
poison can melt crops, so be
careful it doesn't melt you!

quests.title: Supreme Ruler of the Swamp
quests.details:
Hunters! It is time to hunt
down the Shogun Ceanataur.
Let us rid the swamp zone of
this menace and expand our
strategic possibilities.
This is a highly classified
hunt. So don't tell a soul!

quests.title: Slay the Great Kut-Ku!
quests.details:
A bird-like Yian Kut-Ku is
attacking people the world
over! It has even shown up
in these very hills! If it
isn't eliminated soon, we're
finished! Show me what
you're made of!

quests.title: Eliminate the Rathalos!
quests.details:
I request the assistance of
only the bravest of hunters
to find and hunt the
Rathalos that has appeared
near here. Of course, a
handsome reward will be paid
upon success.

quests.title: Attack of the Rathian
quests.details:
My caravan was wiped out by
the queen of the skies, the
killer Rathian! I'll pay you
whatever you ask if you hunt
down that foul creature!
Help me kind hunter, you're
my only hope!

quests.title: Sinking Feeling
quests.details:
As usual, I went into the
mountains on my hunt for
Popos; however, today they
were frightened and fled to
the summit. Something must
be up there... Please get
the Popo Tongues for me!

quests.title: The Taboo of Negligence!
quests.details:
The Mountain Herb, one of
the seven sacred mountain
flowers, truly captures the
spirit of the mountains.
There shouldn't be any
wyverns in this weather, so
you may gather with ease.

quests.title: Basic Training - Basics
quests.details:
I am your esteemed
instructor. First, I shall
have you deliver some Raw
Meat. Slay a Popo in the
wild, and deliver the meat
to the Delivery Box in camp.
Good luck.

quests.title: Basic Training - BBQ
quests.details:
Your esteemed instructor
once again. Now we will
cover BBQ training. Carve
Raw Meat from a Popo and
then use the BBQ Spit to
cook a tasty steak. It's my
dinner, so don't burn it!

quests.title: Basic Training - Gathering
quests.details:
Another lesson from your
esteemed instructor. Today
you will train in gathering
Honey. Snowy mountain Honey
is less sweet but more
fragrant than regular honey.
A real treat with manly men!

quests.title: Basic Training - Combining
quests.details:
Take some advice from your
esteemed instructor, if
there is one thing a hunter
cannot go without, it is
a Potion. Drink it when
injured and all will be
well. Never forget this!

quests.title: Basic Training - Fishing
quests.details:
Once again you come before
your esteemed instructor.
Your next quest is to
deliver a Sushifish. Use
bait near the waterside and
catch a big one. Just
deliver it before dinner!

quests.title: Basic Training - Transport
quests.details:
I am truly esteemed,
especially as an instructor.
Today's quest is to snatch a
Carnivore Egg and return it
to camp. This may be
training, but it is no
opportunity to slack!

quests.title: Basic Training - Hunting
quests.details:
You will hold me in great
esteem as I say this is the
last basic training quest.
You must hunt down the
fierce Giadrome. Stare death
in the face and show your
true hunting spirit.

quests.title: Sword Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the
key to Sword mastery is the
jumping attack. Gauge the
distance of the jump and
then unleash a string of
deadly attacks!

quests.title: Dual Blade Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the
key to Dual Blade mastery is
the timing of Demonization.
Don't wait for a chance to
Demonize, Demonize and
create your own chances.

quests.title: Great Sword Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the
key to Great Sword mastery
is using ready attacks and
charge slices. View your
enemy and decide if a quick
cut or strong slice is best.

quests.title: Long Sword Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the
key to Long Sword mastery
lies in the Spirit gauge. If
you can fill the gauge, your
attack power will increase
greatly! Fill it up!

quests.title: Hammer Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the
key to Hammer mastery is the
charge attack. An attack
should be charged to the
right level then released.
Time the hit with your soul!

quests.title: Hunting Horn Mastery
quests.details:
I, your instructor, must
inform you that the key to
Horn mastery is in the
Recital. String together 2
white notes to make yourself
strong, then claim victory
before the effect wears off.

quests.title: Lance Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the
key to Lance mastery is
guarding. Use the Lance to
block an approaching
monster's attack then
counter fiercely!

quests.title: Gunlance Mastery
quests.details:
As your esteemed instructor,
I must inform you that the 
key to Gunlance mastery is
bombardment. Blast armored
monsters into submission,
then take that chance to
unleash Wyvern's Fire!

quests.title: Light Bowgun Mastery
quests.details:
Esteemed instructor here,
remember the key to the
Light Bowgun is ammo
selection. Select your ammo
depending on the monster and
situation. Master the
qualities of each shot!

quests.title: Heavy Bowgun Mastery
quests.details:
Your esteemed instructor
reminds you that the key to
the Heavy Bowgun is judging
the proper distance. A
Bowgun's advantages aren't
limited to long distances,
so pick the right distance!

quests.title: Bow Mastery
quests.details:
Your esteemed instructor
reminds you that the key to
Bow mastery is charging.
Charge the power of the Bow
and then release it at the
perfect moment. Charged
arrows are a unique beast!
